title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - PowerConstraint
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/PowerConstraint. The actual power constraint contained in the Allowed Limit Range or Power limit. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PowerConstraint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

allowedLimitRange.description: Relationship. This property indicates the various AllowedLimitRanges or PowerLimits that this PowerConstraint object consists of. Relationship to AllowedLimitRange.

hasConsequenceType.description: Property. The consequence type associated with this Power Constraint, which can be Defer or Vanish. Controlled vocabulary (PowerEnvelopeConsequenceType).

hasStartTime.description: Property. The moment this constraint becomes valid.

hasEndTime.description: Property. The moment until which this constraint is valid. ISO 8601 duration (e.g. 'PT30M').
